meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: 它把 Google Chat 适配器接入你的项目：从 channels 分支复制适配器与注册测试到 src/channels/，在渠道入口追加一行 import，安装 @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0，再构建并跑那条注册测试。Google Cloud 凭据需你自己配置。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目接入 Google Chat 渠道时。若正在 /setup 流程中，装完回到该流程；否则运行 /manage-channels 把渠道接到 agent group。

say.text: 给项目加上 Google Chat 渠道，把适配器装好并跑测试。
say.note: 复制适配器、加注册 import、装依赖、构建并测试。

say.text: Google Chat 里的消息到不了 agent，帮我排查。
say.note: 检查 webhook 端口与 .env 里的凭据。

howto.what_en: It copies the Google Chat adapter and registration test from the channels branch into src/channels/, appends a self-registration import, installs @chat-adapter/gchat@4.29.0, then builds and runs the test. Google Cloud setup is manual.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to add a Google Chat channel to the project, or need the adapter in place before /manage-channels. If you're mid /setup, return to that flow after.

say_en.text: Add the Google Chat channel to the project and install the adapter.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, adds import, installs dep, builds, tests.

say_en.text: Here's my Google Chat service account JSON — save it to .env as one line.
say_en.note: Writes GCHAT_CREDENTIALS; an existing value stays.

say_en.text: Messages from Google Chat aren't reaching the agent — help me debug.
say_en.note: Checks the webhook port and .env credentials.
